name: Greenfinch Restaurant & Bar
notes: Restaurant's own site (estancialajolla.com/greenfinch-restaurant) does not embed a priced menu in static HTML. Wine-by-the-glass/bottle items with multiple price tiers were recorded at the first (lower) listed price. 166 total line items captured.
